newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks at unofficial record close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks at unofficial record close.

text.p: The Mexican bolsa was very sharply up at the close of trade on Wednesday.

Foreign and local buyers swamped the market to rearrange portfolios in the wake of recent second quarter earnings, driven by bullish international markets and local interest rate cuts, dealers and analysts said.
Preliminary figures showed the leading IPC share index was up 160.28 points when the closing bell rang, or 3.34 percent, at a previously unseen 4,957.77.
